paper_sections.title: Glucose metabolism and serotonin receptors in the frontotemporal lobe degeneration.
Positron Emission Tomography Data Analysis and Statistics
Calculation of [11C]MDL100,907 Positron Emission Tomography Binding Images

description.value: The study examined whether apathetic and disinhibited behavioral syndromes in the frontal variant of frontotemporal lobar degeneration are associated with distinct regional patterns of cerebral glucose hypometabolism, and measured cerebral 5-HT2A receptor density in a subset of patients.

design.value: Cross-sectional case-control PET study of 18 patients with the frontal variant of frontotemporal lobar degeneration, including apathetic and disinhibited subgroups, compared with healthy control subjects; a subset also underwent [11C]MDL100,907 PET for 5-HT2A receptor binding.

description.value: Eight of 18 fv-FTLD patients were recruited for the [11C]MDL100,907 studies; five were apathetic and three were disinhibited.
Six healthy volunteers were recruited for the [11C]MDL100,907 studies.

task_description.value: 18FDG PET was acquired in resting state, with eyes closed and ears unplugged, after intravenous injection.
In vivo expression of 5-HT2A receptors was measured using [11C]MDL100,907 as a tracer.

instrument.value: GE Advance PET scanner (GE-Advance; General Electric Medical Systems, Milwaukee, WI)

description.value: A 10-minute transmission scan was started 40 minutes after tracer injection and was followed by a three-dimensional static emission scan lasting 15 minutes. Intravenous injection was 185 to 296 MBq 18FDG.
A 10-minute transmission scan was conducted. The 3D dynamic emission scans started with intravenous tracer injection of 19 to 37 MBq [11C]MDL100,907 (5 ml in 10 seconds) and lasted for 60 minutes.

description.value: Image preprocessing included spatial normalization to an 18FDG PET reference template in MNI standard stereotactic space and gaussian smoothing.

steps.value: spatial normalization to an 18FDG PET reference template in MNI standard stereotactic space
gaussian smoothing with a 3D kernel of 8 × 8 × 8 mm full-width at half-maximum

description.value: Binding potential images were calculated by dividing pixel-by-pixel radioactivity concentration images collected between 60 and 90 minutes after injection by the mean radioactivity concentration sampled in cerebellum.

steps.value: collect radioactivity concentration images between 60 and 90 minutes after injection
sample mean radioactivity concentration in cerebellum as reference region
divide pixel-by-pixel radioactivity concentration images by cerebellar mean concentration to calculate binding potential images

model_settings.value: Global differences in tracer uptake, age, education, and disease duration were covaried out; comparisons used t statistics with appropriate linear contrasts; statistical threshold p < 0.001 and p < 0.01 for direct comparisons.

estimator.value: t statistics with appropriate linear contrasts

model_settings.value: Differences in the distribution density of 5-HT2A receptors were assessed by voxel-based comparison of [11C]MDL100,907 binding images between eight patients and six healthy control subjects; statistical threshold p < 0.001.
